XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Turbocharger pressure sensor

  • Fault: Reduced performance occurs sporadically at high speeds and when the engine is under load.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: Faulty turbocharger pressure sensor

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the turbocharger pressure sensor and, if necessary, replace it.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located in the engine compartment, connected to the intake manifold.
